entities.name: Shell MRPL Aviation Fuels & Services Limited

industry: Energy > Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels > Petroleum Products > Refineries & Marketing

operating_notes.text: Company operates in a single segment, the downstream petroleum sector.
Company intends to opt for the lower tax rate under Section 115BAA from FY27, with an effective rate of 25.168% against 34.044%.
PNGRB authorized MRPL for a 2.5 MMTPA ATF pipeline from Devangonthi to Kempegowda International Airport, Bengaluru, to be executed in 36 months.

BSE and NSE fined MRPL ₹5,68,760 each (including 18% GST) for non-compliance with LODR Regulations 17(1), 18(1), 19, 20 and 21(2) on board and sub-committee composition for the quarter ended 31 March 2026.
H1FY27 net cash from operations was ₹6,008.98 Cr against EBITDA of ₹4,596.53 Cr, helped by a ₹4,721.86 Cr rise in trade payables and other liabilities.
Inventories rose to ₹16,749.90 Cr at 30-Sep-2026 from ₹14,421.56 Cr at 31-Mar-2026.
Effective tax rate falls to 25.168% from 34.944% from FY2026-27 under Section 200 of the Income Tax Act, 2025.

holders.name: Investor Education And Protection Fund Authority Ministry Of Corporate Affairs

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹28,493.04 Cr (+3.2% YoY), net profit ₹116.99 Cr.
MRPL announced participation in a 50:25:25 petrochemicals marketing joint venture with ONGC and OPaL with a ₹12.5 Cr equity contribution.
MRPL won a CESTAT appeal setting aside a ₹1,617.82 Cr customs demand on reformats classification and making it eligible for a ₹212.53 Cr refund.
MRPL received PNGRB authorization to lay a 2.5 MMTPA ATF pipeline from Devangonthi to Bengaluru airport fuel farm stations within 36 months.

2026-05-28: MRPL received BSE and NSE notices fining it ₹5,68,760 each (GST included) for board and sub-committee composition non-compliance in the quarter ended 31 March 2026; it has sought a waiver.
ONGC reported a cumulative 88.58% promoter stake in MRPL with zero encumbrance for the year ended March 31, 2026.
MRPL disclosed that promoters HPCL and ONGC held an unencumbered 88.58% stake as of March 31, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹35,590.4 Cr (+37.1% YoY), net profit ₹1,900.76 Cr (+203.0% YoY).
